name: phosphoinositide-3-kinase regulatory subunit 1

function.text: PIK3R1 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase regulatory subunit alpha. Annotated molecular activities include phosphatidylinositol kinase activity and 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase regulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of RNA splicing and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to PIK3R1-related immunodeficiency and SHORT syndrome (autosomal dominant); SHORT syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Metaplastic breast carcinoma; Endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
